The external users are the *_projectors_sum, *_eigen and *_complement_projection lemmas, which have no simp interface issues. findings.declaration: cavityGroupLift (simp interface: cavityGroupLift_support and the missing positive-case lemma)
findings.excerpt: fun i j => if hi : g i = a then B (e ⟨i, hi⟩) j else 0
findings.problem: cavityGroupLift is a dite-valued definition with no simp lemmas for its two cases. cavityGroupLift_support covers only the g i ≠ a case, and it is not tagged @[simp]. There is no lemma for the g i = a case. As a result, nearly every proof in the file unfolds the definition by name: `simp only [cavityGroupLift, hk, dite_true]` (gram), `simp only [cavityGroupLift, hi, dite_true, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]` (restrict), and the long lists in cavityGroupLift_projection, which repeat cavityGroupLift, dite_true and dite_false. Each proof then depends on the dite body and must add the dite_true or dite_false cleanup. There is also no canonical normal form for the lifted entry B (e ⟨i,_⟩) j.
findings.proposed_change: Add two apply lemmas. The first is `@[simp] lemma cavityGroupLift_apply_of_eq (hi : g i = a) (j) : cavityGroupLift g a e B i j = B (e ⟨i, hi⟩) j`. The second is the existing support lemma, tagged `@[simp]`, with `hi : g i ≠ a`. Simp can discharge both hypotheses from hypotheses such as hi or hj that are already in the simp set. The proofs of cavityGroupLift_gram, _restrict and _projection can then use `simp only [cavityGroupLift_apply_of_eq, cavityGroupLift_support, hi, hj]` instead of unfolding the definition. Optionally make the definition irreducible for simp so that later proofs cannot unfold it by accident.
findings.benefit: The definition is no longer unfolded at each use. The case split is stated once as rewrite rules, and the proofs of the lift lemmas become shorter and less sensitive to the exact form of the dite.

findings.declaration: cavityNormalizeFrame_spectral_support (use of cavitySpectralImage in simp; missing apply lemmas)
findings.problem: cavitySpectralImage (g i = a then A i j else 0) has no apply simp lemmas. This proof therefore unfolds it by name and uses a `change (∑ k : Fin n, cavitySpectralImage g A a i k * _) = 0` that relies on defeq of matrix multiplication. The same unfolding appears in CavityOrientedProjectors and CavitySpectralImages, so the interface gap is repeated across the project. Only a projection to the row-support fact is needed here. Simp should be able to rewrite `cavitySpectralImage g A a i k` to 0 when `g i ≠ a`, and to `A i k` when `g i = a`.
findings.proposed_change: In CavitySpectralImages, add `cavitySpectralImage_apply_of_eq` and `cavitySpectralImage_apply_of_ne` (hypotheses `g i = a` and `g i ≠ a`), both tagged @[simp]. Optionally add a general `@[simp] cavitySpectralImage_apply`. Then rewrite the proof as `simp [Matrix.mul_apply, cavityNormalizeFrame, cavitySpectralImage_apply_of_ne _ _ _ hi]`, or use the `Finset.sum_eq_zero` proof with the rewrite lemma instead of unfolding the definition.
findings.benefit: Callers get a stable entry-wise normal form for the spectral image. The proofs stop depending on the dite or ite body of the definition and on defeq `change` steps.
